learningObjective: Write and run KQL (Kusto Query Language) queries in Log Analytics to filter, summarise and chart monitoring data.
engineer: How KQL reads: start with a table, then pipe (|) the rows through one step after another, top to bottom. For example: Perf | where … | summarize … | render timechart.

The main steps: where, keeps matching rows; project, keeps only the columns you list; extend, adds a calculated column; summarize, groups and counts (count(), avg(), max(), percentile()) by columns or by time with bin(TimeGenerated, 1h); order by or sort; take or limit, the first N rows; top; join; render, draws a chart (timechart, barchart).
Time: use the time range picker, or where TimeGenerated > ago(1h). Use bin() to group rows into time buckets for charts.
Query 1, which machines stopped reporting: Heartbeat | summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer | where LastSeen < ago(5m)
Query 2, who deleted things: AzureActivity | where OperationNameValue endswith 'DELETE'
Query 3, CPU over time: Perf | where CounterName == '% Processor Time' | summarize avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | render timechart
Scope: the whole workspace, or resource context (only one resource's data). Save queries, pin them to dashboards or workbooks, and use them in log search alerts.

example.title: Finding the busiest VMs
body: Perf | where CounterName == "% Processor Time" | summarize AvgCPU = avg(CounterValue) by Computer | order by AvgCPU desc | take 5 shows vm-db1 at the top. A timechart by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) shows its CPU rising all morning.

architectureDecisions: Save and share good queries: put them in query packs.
Filter early: filter by time and table first, so queries are faster and cheaper.

misconceptions.reality: No. Only the results and the 'by' columns are left.

comparisons.difference: KQL reads top to bottom with pipes: Perf | where … | summarize …, instead of SELECT … FROM … GROUP BY.

troubleshooting.cause: The time range is too short, the filters are too strict, or the data isn't collected.
troubleshooting.fix: Widen the time range. Check the table has data with … | take 10.

troubleshooting.cause: That column doesn't exist in that table.
troubleshooting.fix: Check the column list in the schema pane.

troubleshooting.cause: It scans big tables without a time filter.
troubleshooting.fix: Filter on TimeGenerated first, and project only the columns you need.

configuration.permissions: Log Analytics Reader on the workspace (or read access to the resources, in resource context)
